basic_info.description: Welcome to the most desirable Marina style barrel front home on a prized block in sunny Potrero Hill! Walk past a colorful facade & planters, sidewalk art, & custom gate to step into the foyer, which opens into a front living room w/ fireplace & formal dining room. The bright, gourmet kitchen is where you'll find a Viking range, built-in appliances, a charming farmhouse sink, & a unique zinc countertop that gives French cafe vibes. All four BDs have direct access to outdoor space. Two BDs upstairs open to an XL deck overlooking the garden that has city & bay views. Two full BAs, one on each level, have an updated, classic look, w/ radiant floor heating & separate shower/tub in the upstairs BA. Two more BDs are downstairs, plus a large multi-purpose den, laundry area, & interior access to a generously sized garage w/ lots of storage & ready-to-install EV charging. The lush, peaceful backyard is perfect for entertaining! When not on the sunny top deck, enjoy the shade below or the happy green garden full of mature plants, flowers, & fruit trees. New roof 2025. Location could not be better, merely steps away from Potrero's popular 18th St, featuring Chez Maman, Farley's, Bloom's Saloon & more! Also nearby the Potrero Public Library, Whole Foods, Jackson Playground, & highway access.
